answers.headline: Over 32 trades from May 2024 to Nov 2026, this made +$252.00 after $208.00 in fees: +$7.88 per trade on average.
what_happened: That average is not reliably different from zero. Given how much single trades vary, the average per trade is likely between -$66.19 and +$113.66: a range that includes losing money.
6 of 32 trades made money (18.8%).
The longest run of losing trades was 10.
With every fill 2% worse than the recorded price, the result would have been -$166.20; it disappears at about 1.2% worse fills.
Without its three best trades the result is -$1,893.50.
Premium paid per trade: median $285.00, largest $540.00. For a bought option that premium is also the most the trade could lose.
The 15% stop meant to limit a loss to about $42.75 per trade (median); the price jumped past it on 24 of 26 losing trades, which lost more than planned.
answers.why_it_matters: A positive total is not evidence of an edge: with this many trades and this much variation, a result like this comes up often by chance. Treat it as a description of what happened, not a strategy that has been shown to work.

what_happened: That average is not reliably different from zero. Given how much single trades vary, the average per trade is likely between -$66.19 and +$113.66: a range that includes losing money.
6 of 32 trades made money (18.8%).
The longest run of losing trades was 10.
With every fill 2% worse than the recorded price, the result would have been -$166.20; it disappears at about 1.2% worse fills.
Without its three best trades the result is -$1,893.50.
Premium paid per trade: median $285.00, largest $540.00. For a bought option that premium is also the most the trade could lose.
The 15% stop meant to limit a loss to about $42.75 per trade (median); the price jumped past it on 24 of 26 losing trades, which lost more than planned.
answers.why_it_matters: A positive total is not evidence of an edge: with this many trades and this much variation, a result like this comes up often by chance. Treat it as a description of what happened, not a strategy that has been shown to work.
